texts.characters:
San diego’s great escape & oasis
is as welcoming as ever

500 W. Broadway, built when San Diego’s identity was tightly tied to its waterfront and naval presence, was an Italian Renaissance masterwork that became a place of welcome and belonging for a growing military community. 

As a YMCA, it was a civic institution that offered lodging, recreation, education and fellowship. Today, we’re proud stewards of that spirit of service, camaraderie and hospitality.
